observation.visible_scene: A bright dance studio with plain white walls, a light wood floor, a wall-mounted air conditioner at upper left, and a full-height mirror along the right side that reflects ceiling track lights and a white curtain. A single female dancer with a high ponytail, wearing a sheer black long-sleeve top, a short black skirt with a thin belt, and black boots, stands in right-facing profile near the mirror; the figure seen 'behind' her in the mirror is her reflection, not a second person.
visible_changes: At the start (frames 1-10) the dancer holds a deep forward torso lean, knees slightly bent, arms hanging straight down with hands near knee level; the pose is largely held with only minor settling.
From about frames 11-20 the hands lift and spread, fingers splayed, coming together in front of the lower body while the torso remains bent forward.
From frames 21-26 the hands draw back toward the hips/sides and the torso begins to rise, the forward lean decreasing.
From frames 27-31 the torso is nearly upright and both arms extend forward horizontally, hands together in front.
From frames 32-41 the arms sweep upward into a diagonal overhead extension, hands rising above head level, while the body stands upright.
The foot placement/stance (one leg bent under the body, the other extended forward) stays essentially fixed throughout; there is no stepping or travel across the floor.
The mirror reflection reproduces every phase of this motion in sync, confirming it is a reflection of the same dancer.
Background elements (AC unit, mirror seam, ceiling lights, curtain) remain in fixed screen positions, indicating a static camera with no pan/zoom.
outside_clip_unknowns: The posture at t=0 is already mid-hold (a sustained forward lean), so the onset of that lean occurred before this excerpt.
The clip ends with the arms still rising/extended overhead; whether they continue upward, pause, or move on to the next choreographic step is not shown.
The larger routine, music, or any preceding/following movements are outside the segment.
uncertain_details: Exact wrist/finger orientation during the hand-together phase is partly obscured by motion blur.
Any very small weight shift in the feet is hard to confirm; the stance appears static but sub-frame foot adjustments cannot be ruled out.
Whether the forward-lean-to-upright transition is one continuous rise or contains a brief hold is only approximately discernible from the sampled frames.
